stories.title: Stephen Curry Extension Window Opens — Warriors Expected to Offer 2-Year, $136.7M Max Deal

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Steph Curry's extension window opens tomorrow.

The Warriors are expected to offer 2 years, $136.7M.

That's $68M/year through his age-40 season.

Draymond's back. GP2 is back. Steph's not going anywhere. 🍾

#Warriors #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Stephen Curry will not request a trade.

He will suit up for Golden State in 2026-27 regardless.

But the Warriors are about to make it official — 2yr/$136.7M max expected.

One more run. On his terms. 💛

#Warriors #NBA

stories.title: Kawhi Leonard Investigation — Raptors Developing Cold Feet, Still Weeks Away

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
New Shams: The Raptors are developing cold feet on the Kawhi trade.

Still weeks away from any resolution.

If no settlement: neutral arbitrator takes over. Case could run into 2027.

This was supposed to be done in June. 🕐

#Raptors #LAClippers #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Kawhi Leonard situation by the numbers:

$50.3M — his 2026-27 salary
$28M — funneled through Aspiration
14 years — Sanberg's prison sentence
0 — trades completed since June 30

Commissioner Silver is "hopeful" for a summer resolution.

Summer ends in 47 days. ⏳

#NBA
